item.text: [{"task_id":"19bb5feb","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['config'][0]))","    panel = int(round(params['config'][1]))","    size = int(round(params['config'][2]))","    low = int(round(params['config'][3]))","    high = int(round(params['config'][4]))","    if size <= 0 or size > 30 or low < 0 or high >= size:","        return grid.copy()","    area = np.argwhere(grid == panel)","    if len(area) == 0:","        return grid.copy()","    center = np.mean(area, axis=0)","    out = np.full((size, size), bg, dtype=int)","    for color in np.unique(grid):","        if color != bg and color != panel:","            points = np.argwhere(grid == color)","            position = np.mean(points, axis=0)","            row = high if position[0] > center[0] else low","            col = high if position[1] > center[1] else low","            out[row, col] = color","    return out"],"shapes":{"config":[5]},"params":{"config":[0,8,2,0,1]},"rationale":"Reduce the cyan rectangle to a 2-by-2 grid, placing each colored square in its corresponding quadrant and leaving absent squares black.
